column3: Close to the Hebrew; “The assembly of faithful people” is rendered “the congregation of the godly ones.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Harp” is rendered “lyre,” and “tambourine” as “timbrel.”
Close to the Hebrew; “He glorifies” is rendered “He will beautify,” and “humble people” as “the afflicted ones.”
Close to the Hebrew; “In honor” is rendered “in glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; “In their throat” is rendered “in their mouth,” “praises” as “high praises,” and “a sword of mouths” as “a two-edged sword.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “This is” before “an honor.”
